# AMC Skeleton Region

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A region frame that, when a refresh takes longer than 400 ms, lays a skeleton with the exact shape of the current content over the body, measured from the report rows, cards, fields and text lines on screen, and never flashes on fast loads.

**Use it for:** Classic Report, Interactive Report, Cards, Chart and Form regions that refresh on filters or Dynamic Actions, and lazy-loading regions with the First load option.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_skeleton_region.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-skeleton-region.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Skeleton Region**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-skeleton-region }`.

Motion region template for regions that refresh. Design principles: Doherty threshold: responses under about 400 ms feel immediate and must not show a loading state, because the flash itself disrupts; loading states: a skeleton that matches the real layout keeps spatial context and feels faster than a spinner, and shimmer respects reduced motion. How it works: on apexbeforerefresh of this region the script measures what is in the body right now, relative to the frame: every line of text, every form field and button, cards and other painted boxes, images, charts and canvases, and a rule under every report row. If apexafterrefresh arrives within data-amc-delay (400 ms) nothing is shown. Otherwise the skeleton is drawn over the body with one slow light sweep, the frame keeps its height so the page does not jump, the stage is aria-busy, and once shown it stays at least data-amc-min-show (350 ms) so it never flickers; then it fades out and a polite status says the region was updated. A 60 second failsafe removes it if no apexafterrefresh arrives. The body itself is never clipped, hidden or transformed. With the First load option an empty body at page load (lazy-loading regions) shows a synthetic shape until content arrives: set data-amc-skeleton="report|cards|form|text" and data-amc-skeleton-rows="5" as region Custom Attributes or on an element in the body. JavaScript API for your own Ajax: amcTplSkeletonRegion.start(element) and stop(element); shape(element) and state(element) for tests. English strings to translate, on the section element in the template or per region as Custom Attributes: data-amc-label-still Still loading, %0 s, data-amc-label-slow %0 is still loading, data-amc-label-done %0 updated (%0 = region title). Timing: data-amc-delay and data-amc-min-show in milliseconds. Reduced motion: a static skeleton with no sweep, pulse or fade. Forced colors: bones use GrayText.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Skeleton on first load | `amc-TSkeletonRegion--firstLoad` | When the body is empty at page load, for lazy-loading regions, a synthetic skeleton is shown after the threshold until content arrives. Shape from data-amc-skeleton. |
| Pulse instead of sweep | `amc-TSkeletonRegion--pulse` | The bones breathe in place instead of a light sweeping across, calmer for dashboards with many regions. |
| Accent bones | `amc-TSkeletonRegion--accent` | Tints the skeleton with the primary color instead of neutral grey. |
| Show elapsed time | `amc-TSkeletonRegion--elapsed` | After 3 seconds the header shows Still loading with the seconds counting, and screen readers hear once that the region is still loading. |
| No body padding | `amc-TSkeletonRegion--noPadding` | Removes side padding so reports and cards run edge to edge. |
